resources.string: Used to import, organize, and write back the contacts you select. Changes are shown before they are written.
Used to read call time, direction, and number so calls can be linked to contacts and follow-ups. Call audio is never recorded.
Used to detect when a call ends so you can add a call note.
Used to import system calendars and check time conflicts. Changes are shown before they are written.

When enabled, ZhiBan recognizes new notifications from allowlisted messaging apps and organizes them on-device for review. Model processing follows your privacy and outbound-data settings. It does not read message history or send messages.

When explicitly enabled, ZhiBan recognizes messages you just sent. If an app hides text, ZhiBan captures the current screen only during a send flow initiated by ZhiBan and performs OCR on-device; screenshots are not stored. It does not click, send messages, or read history.
Personal data is stored on-device by default. Processing by a connected model follows your privacy and outbound-data settings.
Before using ZhiBan, review the required system permissions, data purposes, and reversible actions.
